mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, policy_version_id, agreed, decision_action, locale, consent_source, created_at FROM user_policy_consents WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND policy_version_id = #{policyVersionId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: c.id, c.user_id, c.policy_version_id, c.agreed, c.decision_action, c.locale, c.consent_source, c.created_at, CAST(c.created_at AS DATETIME(6)) AS decision_wall_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_policy_consents c JOIN policy_versions v ON v.id = c.policy_version_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND v.policy_type = #{policyType} AND c.created_at <= #{asOf} AND c.agreed = 1 AND (c.decision_action = 'AGREE' OR c.decision_action IS NULL) ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM user_policy_consents c JOIN policy_versions v ON v.id = c.policy_version_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND v.policy_type = #{policyType} AND c.created_at <= #{asOf} AND (c.decision_action = 'WITHDRAW' OR (c.decision_action IS NULL AND c.agreed = 0)) ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM user_policy_consents c JOIN policy_versions v ON v.id = c.policy_version_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND v.policy_type = #{policyType} AND COALESCE(v.consent_basis_version_id, v.id) != #{basisId} AND c.created_at <= #{asOf} AND c.agreed = 1 AND (c.decision_action IS NULL OR c.decision_action = 'AGREE') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_policy_consents newer JOIN policy_versions newer_version ON newer_version.id = newer.policy_version_id WHERE newer.user_id = c.user_id AND newer_version.policy_type = v.policy_type AND COALESCE(newer_version.consent_basis_version_id, newer_version.id) = COALESCE(v.consent_basis_version_id, v.id) AND newer.id > c.id AND newer.created_at <= #{asOf} ) ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE destination_comment_images i JOIN destination_comments c ON c.id = i.comment_id SET i.gallery_status = 'REVOKED', i.gallery_consent_withdrawn_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND i.gallery_license_policy_id IS NULL AND i.gallery_status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_policy_consents (user_id, policy_version_id, agreed, decision_action, locale, consent_source) VALUES (#{userId}, #{policyVersionId}, #{agreed}, #{decisionAction}, #{locale}, #{consentSource})
mapper.select: SELECT u.id FROM users u WHERE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_policy_consents c WHERE c.user_id = u.id ) ORDER BY u.deleted_at, u.id LIMIT #{limit}
